# Menus and commands controls

Commands, menu strips and context menus.

(api-gui-forms-menustrip)=
## MenuStrip

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/menu_strip/menu_strip.hpp>
class MenuStrip final : public Control
```

MenuStrip is the retained top-level menu coordinator. It lays out root items, tracks hot and active identities, transfers navigation across an owned ContextMenu, supports mnemonic and semantic entry, and exposes caller-controlled item padding while keeping invocation and open-state events ordered.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `MenuStrip`.

- A retained focusable menu bar. Root items are laid out by the strip; popup rows share `Command` authority with pointer, keyboard, and semantic activation through an owned `ContextMenu`.
- `use_mnemonic` removes markers from top-level width, paint, and semantics; duplicate top-level mnemonics cycle deterministically.
- Overflow and hosted ToolStrip controls remain open.

| --- | --- |

(api-gui-forms-contextmenu)=
## ContextMenu

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/components/context_menu/context_menu.hpp>
class ContextMenu final : public Component
```

ContextMenu is a nonvisual owner for a retained, focus-scoped popup menu tree. Its implementation controls transient lifetime, submenu chains, enabled/check state, root handoff, outside-pointer policy, invocation ordering, and caller-configurable preferred width without exposing implementation rows as reusable public controls.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ContextMenuStrip`.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ContextMenu(std::string stable_id)` | Constructs a menu owner with stable identity and detached authored item state. |
| `~ContextMenu() override` | Revokes popup leases, focus scope, subscriptions, and implementation controls before destruction. |
| `const std::string& stable_id() const noexcept` | Returns the stable identity prefix used for popup layers, panels, rows, and semantics. |
| `const std::vector<MenuItemSpec>& items() const noexcept` | Returns the authored root menu-item tree. |
| `void set_items(std::vector<MenuItemSpec> items)` | Validates item identities and submenu topology, replaces the model, and rebuilds an open presentation safely. |
| `double preferred_width() const noexcept` | Returns the logical minimum width requested for each menu panel. |
| `void set_preferred_width(double width)` | Validates bounded panel width and rebuilds live menu geometry when open. |
| `void show(const Control::Ptr& owner, const Point window_position, const MenuOpenMode mode = MenuOpenMode::keyboard)` | Opens the menu relative to an invoker and anchor point under a new popup and focus-scope lease. |
| `void close() noexcept` | Closes the complete submenu chain, revokes transient ownership, and publishes a real open-state transition. |
| `bool is_open() const noexcept` | Reports whether the root popup lease remains connected. |
| `Event<const MenuItemInvocation&>& item_invoked() noexcept` | Returns the event published after an enabled leaf is committed and the transient chain closes. |
| `Event<bool>& open_changed() noexcept` | Returns the event published when root transient ownership opens or closes. |

(api-gui-forms-command)=
## Command

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/commands/command/command.hpp>
class Command final : public Component
```

Command is the shared retained authority for multiple presentations, with validated UTF-8 state and ordered enabled-only invocation.

Status: stable. No WinForms counterpart.
